# Working in this repository

This is the **public marketing and application-information site** for Elia,
served at <https://getelia.app> via GitHub Pages.

## The one thing that breaks work here

**Every `.html` file is generated by `tools/generate_i18n.py`** — including the
English pages at the root, and `sitemap.xml`. Editing HTML by hand looks like it
works and is then silently overwritten on the next generator run. This has
already cost one regression.

Change content in `tools/generate_i18n.py`, then run:

```bash
python3 tools/generate_i18n.py
```

`assets/css/styles.css` is the exception — it is hand-written and not generated.

## Scope boundaries

This repository is **not an Elia Platform client**. Do not design or implement
here: Elia Account login, family invitation flows, account management, Premium
management, synchronization, cloud data access, a family dashboard, or Supabase
integration. The site has no backend, no authenticated user area, and handles no
private family data. It has no current runtime dependency on Elia Platform.

- **Application implementation** belongs in the private application
  repositories. Pages here describe app behavior; they never define it. If the
  site and an app repository disagree, the app repository is right.
- **Account, family, Premium, synchronization, cloud, and security architecture**
  live in the private Elia Platform repository. Do not model platform concepts
  here — no data scopes, no sync entity lists, no backend architecture.
- **A platform-facing web client is not approved and not planned.** If a task
  seems to require one, stop and raise it rather than starting the work.

This repository is public. Do not put private repository URLs, SSH clone
addresses, workspace names, or other internal topology into it.

See [`docs/elia-ecosystem.md`](docs/elia-ecosystem.md) for the full boundary.

## Conventions

- Internal links are root-relative and end in a slash (`/apps/feeding/`), never
  `index.html`. Canonical URLs, `hreflang`, and `sitemap.xml` must all agree.
- Three languages: English (root), German (`de/`), Spanish (`es/`). A copy change
  in one language means the same change in the other two.
- Privacy pages here mirror each app's own policy — update them together with
  the application repository, never independently.
- Do not invent repository URLs or product decisions. Record unknowns as
  explicit `TODO:` markers or open questions with complete question text.

## Verifying a change

Serve the site and check that pages and links resolve:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
```
